address: via Privata Fratelli Gabba 7/b, Milan, 20121, Italy
bio: Housed within the Bulgari hotel, a secluded haven of elegance right in the heart of the most exclusive district in Milan, this restaurant alternates the trusted chefs at its helm, all of whom continue to serve light, contemporary Italian cuisine in dishes that focus more on substance than form. Choose between tasting menus and a generous à la carte selection featuring meat and fish dishes alike, including classic local favourites such as risotto and vitello alla Milanese (breaded veal cutlet)....
